query: Load the LAS files in /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/well_logs/task_001 into a single table with one column each for gamma ray, bulk density, neutron porosity and sonic, depths in feet below ground level, keyed by 14-digit API number. Then give me the mean of each curve per well. Save the per-well means to /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/out/<ARM>/wli-001/curve_means.csv.

Build a composite gamma ray log for the well in /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/well_logs/task_002 from its two logging runs. Save it to /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/out/<ARM>/wli-002/composite_gr.csv and report the mean GR between 6,400 and 6,600 ft.
Convert the log in /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/well_logs/task_003 to TVDSS in feet and save it to /Volumes/energy_catalog/energy_skills/eval/out/<ARM>/wli-003/tvdss.csv.
